title: Design System: Didáctica Viajes
scope: src/app/(sitios)/didactica/ only; not a project-wide system

display.purpose: Hero lema only; white over the photo, two lines max.

statement.purpose: Scroll-filled trajectory sentence; same family scales to the blue pull-quote (clamp(1.5rem,2.6vw,2.25rem)/1.2) and the work-band h3 (clamp(1.875rem,3.2vw,2.75rem)/1.08).

counter.purpose: Proof figures in Didáctica Blue, tabular digits, count-up on view.

title.purpose: List and definition titles; destination names 22/26px; subsection h3 20px; quote card title 22px.

body-lg.purpose: Section intros and hero subtext (20px md in hero), 46-52ch.

body.purpose: Descriptions and definitions at 15-17px, 60ch max; Slate Text on light, White 70-88% on dark.

label.purpose: Form labels and type-of-trip lines; sentence case, never tracked or uppercase.

control.purpose: Text inside pills; 15px semibold in nav links and chips.

alpha.name: ink-60
alpha.purpose: Helper caption under the quote button.

alpha.name: ink-8
alpha.purpose: Nav ring, flag ring, destination row dividers.

shadows.name: disc-float
shadows.purpose: Circular photos in the scrolling strip.

scrims.name: hero-scrim
scrims.purpose: Top-heavy scrim under hero copy; keeps the group visible at the bottom.

scrims.name: band-scrim
scrims.purpose: Bottom scrim under the 'Nuestra gente' copy on the Cruz Roja band.

glass.name: nav-glass
glass.value: background: rgba(255,255,255,0.88); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(27,37,47,0.08)

glass.name: card-glass
glass.value: background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.6)
glass.purpose: Quote card over the hero sky.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for every transition, reveal and count-up.

motion.name: hero-intro
motion.value: stagger 90ms, delay 150ms (copy) / 450ms (quote card); items translateY 24px -> 0, 0.9s; h1 blur 6px -> 0

motion.name: media-reveal
motion.value: clip-path inset(100% 0 0 0) -> inset(0), 1.1s ease-in-out; inner scale 1.08 -> 1, 1.6s ease-out

motion.name: parallax
motion.value: translateY -50px -> 50px across scroll, inner layer scaled to hide edges

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all travel/blur/clip removed; opacity-only or static

layout.name: hero
layout.value: min-height 78svh; lg 100svh capped 1000px; copy top-left; quote card 400px absolute top-right on lg, -48px overlap below lg

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Yellow pill with an ink arrow disc flush to the right edge; the 'Cotiza tu viaje' ask in hero and contact.
components.html: Cotiza tu viaje
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; height: 56px; padding: 0 6px 0 24px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #FFDE01; color: #1B252F; font-family: Fredoka, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary__disc { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #1B252F; color: #FFDE01; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #FFE94D; } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-btn-primary__disc { transform: translateX(2px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Nav Button
components.description: Compact yellow pill in the floating nav and mobile panel.
components.css: .ds-btn-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #FFDE01; color: #1B252F; font-family: Fredoka, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-nav:hover { background: #FFE94D; } .ds-btn-nav:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.description: Fredoka link with a trailing arrow that nudges right on hover; 'Ver destinos' on the hero, 'Cotizar' on destination rows.
components.html: Ver destinos
components.css: .ds-link-arrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #1B252F; font-family: Fredoka, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-link-arrow svg { transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-link-arrow:hover svg { transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-link-arrow:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.description: Cool-paper pill naming a national destination; hover turns yellow and the chip preselects the quote composer.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #F4F5FA; color: #1B252F; font-family: 'Nunito Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #FFDE01; } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Pill select/input with bold label; blue border and soft blue ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; color: #1B252F; font-family: 'Nunito Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-field__wrap { position: relative; display: block; } .ds-field__control { appearance: none; width: 100%; height: 48px; padding: 0 40px 0 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(27,37,47,0.12); border-radius: 9999px; background: #fff; color: #1B252F; font-family: inherit; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 400; outline: none; transition: border-color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-field__control::placeholder { color: rgba(27,37,47,0.45); } .ds-field__control:focus { border-color: #2E3091; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(46,48,145,0.14); } .ds-field__caret { position: absolute; right: 16px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); color: rgba(27,37,47,0.55); pointer-events: none; }

components.css: .ds-quote { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; max-width: 400px; padding: 24px; border-radius: 24px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); box-shadow: 0 24px 60px -24px rgba(14,18,80,0.45), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.6); color: #1B252F; font-family: 'Nunito Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-quote__title { margin: 0; font-family: Fredoka, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-quote__label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-quote__input { height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(27,37,47,0.12); border-radius: 9999px; background: #fff; font: inherit; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 400; outline: none; transition: border-color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-quote__input:focus { border-color: #2E3091; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(46,48,145,0.14); } .ds-quote__btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 4px; height: 56px; padding: 0 8px 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: #FFDE01; color: #1B252F; font-family: Fredoka, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-quote__disc { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #1B252F; color: #FFDE01; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-quote__btn:hover { background: #FFE94D; } .ds-quote__btn:hover .ds-quote__disc { transform: translateX(2px); } .ds-quote__btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-quote__hint { margin: 0; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.375; color: rgba(27,37,47,0.6); }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; height: 64px; max-width: 1120px; padding: 0 8px 0 20px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.88); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); box-shadow: 0 18px 50px -22px rgba(14,18,80,0.45), 0 0 0 1px rgba(27,37,47,0.08); color: #1B252F; font-family: 'Nunito Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav__logo { font-family: Fredoka, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 22px; color: #2E3091; } .ds-nav__links { display: flex; gap: 32px; } .ds-nav__links a { position: relative; color: rgba(27,37,47,0.8); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms ease; } .ds-nav__links a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -3px; height: 1px; background: currentColor; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: right center; transition: transform 250ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-nav__links a:hover { color: #1B252F; } .ds-nav__links a:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); transform-origin: left center; } .ds-nav__cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #FFDE01; color: #1B252F; font-family: Fredoka, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 200ms ease, transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-nav__cta:hover { background: #FFE94D; } .ds-nav__cta:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

narrative.overview:
The page is built from Didáctica's own group photographs and treats them as the ground everything else sits on. Type, surfaces and controls are kept quiet and round so the London Eye, the Mexican flag and the neon-scarf groups carry the emotion; the copy and the quote composer state the offer in one beat and get out of the way. Density is low and the rhythm is long: 96 to 128px between sections, one idea per band, generous white and cool-paper gaps.

The palette is a strict two-tone of blue-tinted ink and Didáctica blue with a single yellow accent reserved for the ask. Fredoka's rounded forms set every headline, counter and control; Nunito Sans carries reading text. Everything that can be pressed is a pill; everything that holds content is a 24px surface. Shadows exist but are tinted with the brand's deep navy and pushed far below the element, so lifted elements read as floating over the photo rather than casting a grey drop.

The build rejects the polaroid-collage brochure of the current Didáctica site and the generic headline-plus-three-cards landing page. There are no eyebrows, no kickers, no decorative icon grids and no invented photo captions.
keyCharacteristics: Photography as ground: full-bleed hero and work band, unequal 12-column gallery, circular photo strip.
One accent (yellow) used only on calls to action, the objective badges and hover states.
Fredoka 500/600 for everything that is not body copy; Nunito Sans 400/700 for body and labels.
Pill controls, 24px surfaces, 1px alpha hairlines; no bordered cards.
Navy-tinted, long-throw shadows on floating elements only (nav, quote card, photo circles).
Scroll-linked and entrance motion on one shared ease-out curve; every effect has a reduced-motion fallback.

rules.name: The One Yellow Rule
rules.body: Yellow appears only where the visitor can act or where the brand marks its three objectives. It never fills a surface, a heading or a decorative shape.

rules.name: The Navy Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow and scrim derives from Scrim Navy, never from black or grey.

rules.name: The Fredoka Everywhere Above Body Rule
rules.body: Any text larger than body copy, and any text inside a control, is Fredoka. Nunito Sans never sets a heading.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: Sections open with the headline itself; there are no eyebrows, overlines or uppercase tracking anywhere on the surface.

rules.name: The Float-Only Rule
rules.body: Shadows belong to elements that sit over a photo or over the page; content in flow (lists, chips, image tiles, blue card) is flat.

dos: Do put yellow only on actions, hover fills and the A/D/S badges; keep its share of any screen small.
Do set every heading, counter and control label in Fredoka (600 for h1/h2/counters/buttons, 500 for statements and titles).
Do use pills for anything pressable and 24px for anything that frames content.
Do tint every shadow and scrim with Scrim Navy (rgba(14,18,80,…)) and keep shadows on floating elements only.
Do separate list rows with 1px Ink 8 to 10% hairlines and generous row padding instead of cards.
Do keep reading text in Slate Text on light surfaces and White 70 to 88% on blue or ink bands, 46 to 60ch wide.
Do keep the hero copy top-left over the sky so the group photo stays unobstructed.
donts: Don't add eyebrows, kickers, overlines or uppercase letter-spaced labels.
Don't fill a surface, heading or decorative shape with yellow, and don't introduce a second accent (red is not used on this surface).
Don't use grey or black shadows, 2px borders or bordered cards.
Don't caption the circular photo strip or the gallery with destination names; the photos are not matched to places.
Don't set headings in Nunito Sans or body copy in Fredoka.
Don't use square corners on any control or content frame.
